explanation: This fires only at D1 (GO and D2 are always 0), and only late in the episode: it stays at 0 before about trial 70, then sits around 2-4 at D1 from about trial 75 to 99. It peaks at 8-10 at D1 when the agent has just chosen a1 after a run of a2 choices, or has had a1 rewarded through common S1 transitions, and it falls back to 2-5 once a1 runs go on for long or the agent goes back to a2.
